messages:
Maria Lopez: quick weekly handoff for Cascade — dedicated pool status.
Aj Singh: thanks. quick numbers?
Maria Lopez: GPU hours last 24h: 1,150h (avg utilization 78%). Peak saturation: 93% in us-west-2 between 03:00-06:00 UTC. Queue depth: median 3, p95 9. Noted a backlog spike at ~03:15 that lasted ~40m.
Tom Archer: saw that spike on traces — P95 token generation rose from ~120ms to ~280ms during the window. Streaming error rate jumped to 4.1% (baseline ~0.6%).
Kai SRE: capacity-bot alerted at 03:12. Autoscaler didn’t add nodes because pool soft cap hit (soft cap 100 GPUs, Cascade committed 96).
Aj Singh: can we borrow burst from overflow? Policy allows temporary burst if spare capacity exists, but need billing sign-off for commit customers. Who can approve immediate relief?
Maria Lopez: I requested manual burst for emergency; noted billing implication in the account doc. Infra has authority for short-lived manual bursts.
deploy-bot: add-burst accepted: +6 gpus to cascade-prod (expires in 3h).
Tom Archer: after +6 GPUs, queue depth dropped to median 1 and P95 returned to ~140ms. Error rate back to 0.9%. Estimated cost delta for the burst window: +$420.
Maria Lopez: action items: 1) CS to ask Cascade to shift long-running fine-tune jobs to off-peak slots; 2) Infra to evaluate increasing soft cap to 110 for that pool; 3) SRE to add a guard so autoscaler can request billing-flagged bursts automatically (with CS approval).
Aj Singh: I'll open INF-2246 for infra soft-cap evaluation and tag @Kai SRE. Also scheduling enablement with Cascade on better job scheduling — proposed Fri 10am PT.
Kai SRE: noted. Also recommend enabling KV prefix caching for their frequent prompt patterns — could reduce token work by ~18%.
Maria Lopez: capture tickets: INF-2246, CS-357 (enablement invite), BILL-190 (billing-override request). I'll send the customer summary and renewal-risk note (minor) today.
Aj Singh: ack :thumbsup:
Maria Lopez: thanks team — follow-up in the account tracker and I'll post a short customer note after the call.
